headline: Continued 14 Davis Circle RDA review and tabled Lake Singletary superseding order of conditions.
summary: A member said he must step aside from the 14 Davis Circle review because he regularly works with the applicant, which left no quorum. The Lake Singletary item was tabled to the next meeting because the chair wanted to take part in the discussion. The commission also approved the minutes from 9/2/26.

Tabled the Lake Singletary superseding order of conditions until the next meeting.

transcript:
# SUTTON CONSERVATION COMMISSION

## Meeting Minutes

October 7, 2026

Approved [signature]

The Chair read the following statement: Pursuant to Governor Healey's directive extending the temporary Open Meeting provisions until June 30, 2027, the Conservation Commission meeting will be conducted in a HYBRID format and will be recorded. *Recordings will be available on the Town's website and YouTube channel. *Please be aware: Participants attending via Zoom will have their video and audio disabled. *If you wish to engage in discussion, raise your hand; if acknowledged by the Chair, you will receive a pop-up message allowing you to unmute yourself. For agenda, YouTube, and Zoom links, please visit www.suttonma.org/cable-department.

Present in person: M. McGovern, T. Thompson, J. Marran

Unavailable: W. Wence, J. Duval

Staff: B. Faneuf -consultant

## Public Hearing(s) - None

## Discussions

### 14 Davis Circle RDA

The Acting Chair read the public meeting notice.

He noted he will need to recuse due to conflict as he regularly does work with/for this applicant. There is therefore no quorum to continue.

Motion: To continue discussion to the meeting of October 21st at 6:15 P.M., T. Thompson

2nd: J. Marran

Vote: 3-0-0, T. Thompson – yes, M. McGovern - yes, J. Marran- yes

### Lake Singletary - Superseding Order of Conditions

The Acting Chair noted the Chair wishes to be part of this discussion so it will be tabled until teh next meeting

## Board Business

### Approve Minutes

Motion: To approve the minutes from 9/2/26 T. Thompson

2nd: J. Marran

Vote: 3-0-0, T. Thompson – yes, M. McGovern - yes, J. Marran- yes

Motion: To adjourn, T. Thompson

2nd: J. Marran

Vote: 3-0-0, T. Thompson – yes, M. McGovern - yes, J. Marran- yes

Adjourned 6:04 PM

### Meeting Materials:

- 14 Davis Circle RDA - Application and Plan
- Lake Singletary – Superseding Order of Conditions
- Draft Minutes 9/16/26
